s: SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Slope Corrector is an accessory used to accommodate slope corrections arising from falls created on concrete surfaces for drainage purposes. Slope correctors are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and can correct for slopes of 1% to 5%.
SikaRoof® VersiJack® K Slope Corrector is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® K and is installed between the top of pedestals and beneath the pavers.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Slope corrector for raised paving installations on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.2.
